name: Dr. A.N. Mukhopadhyay Needy Student Fund (B.Sc. Agriculture - Final Year Student)
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student in need of financial support to continue their education. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the final year of the B.Sc. Agriculture course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The financial assistance is awarded for a duration of one year only.
